descriptionInUI: Requires Motor Pool. Existing road convoys advance by a configurable distance per turn and resume from their saved position. Long road legs take several turns. Disabling the plugin pauses its existing journeys without removing their units. Armor groups show transport requirements and tractor shortages; the API can preview routes. Armor-group and SAM movement commands are not available yet. Off by default.

specificOptions.descriptionInUI: Road travel budget per turn, in statute miles. Default 120 miles (193.1 km). Long journeys continue over several turns. Road and off-road portions share one turn's budget.
Cross-country travel budget per turn, in statute miles. Default 60 miles (96.6 km), half the road budget. Includes access to and from roads.
